result.hard_numeric_fact_text: Crisil (14 Oct 2026) initial A+/Stable rating on Rs400 cr bank lines; FY26 operating income Rs1,038 cr; capacity Indri malt 12->30 KLPD and distillery 78->220 KLPD plus 200 KLPD greenfield Chhattisgarh commissioned. Rating agency forecast FY27 revenue +50-60% is an ANALYST ESTIMATE.
result.thesis: Premium single malt (Indri) scale-up with newly commissioned capacity; Crisil assigns A+/Stable and forecasts FY27 revenue +50-60% at 22-24% margins. But reported Q1 revenue was only +16.7% YoY, EBITDA margin 17.6% (below the 22.5% Crisil cites for FY26 - definitions differ, unreconciled), receivables +77% vs revenue +27%, ND/EBITDA 2.15, dilution 4.5%, and P/E 40.7 already prices a lot. The Crisil forecast, not reported numbers, carries the acceleration case.
chain_missing_links: Revenue acceleration not yet reported (Q1 +16.7% vs Crisil 50-60% FY27)
result.demand_signal: Premiumisation of Indian alco-bev; Indri awards (MANAGEMENT/ANALYST ESTIMATE, Crisil)
result.supply_signal: Aged-whisky barrel inventory is a moat but no shortage data
result.pricing_signal: unknown; no ASP data in extracted text
result.capacity_catalyst: Commissioned: malt 30 KLPD, distillery 220 KLPD, Chhattisgarh 200 KLPD; ramp is the catalyst (FACT per Crisil rationale; utilisation unknown)
result.cfo_to_pat: 0.86 FY (class A per dossier); WC intensive from ageing inventory
result.debt: ND/EBITDA 2.15; interest cover 5.0; gearing ~0.6x (Crisil); WCDL Rs145 cr; cash Rs70 cr
result.valuation: TTM P/E 40.7; EV/EBITDA 26.1; PEG 3.27; implied EPS ~Rs14.3

plausible.2x: NO: needs EPS ~Rs30 at 38x within 2y vs Q1 growth +16%
